about: Type systems for native apps. Text stays the platform face (SF Pro / Roboto) so Dynamic Type, accessibility and native controls keep working; the voice lives in the display role (titles, verdicts, numerals, the vocabulary's labels). iOS display faces listed here ship with iOS (no bundling, licence-free on Apple platforms). Apple faces may not be bundled into Android builds: the android column names an OFL/free face to bundle there (cross-platform stacks bundle that face for Android and may bundle it for iOS too). Spent faces (knowledge/priors.md) are deliberately absent. Bundling for renders and builds: on macOS most of these faces sit in /System/Library/Fonts(/Supplemental) as .ttc collections — `kinetic font split <file.ttc> --out fonts/` writes one .ttf per face. When the Android face has no offline source in a sandbox, render with the iOS face and name the Android face in KDL `system.type.families` for the build. Labels, kickers, meta and buttons always use the platform text face at ≥ 13pt (≥ 15pt when the audience is older or tired): a display face's voice belongs to sentences and numbers, not to 9pt small caps.

systems.name: Wide signage
systems.rule: expanded only at >= 22pt; body never expanded; React Native cannot select SF width/optical variants through fontFamily — on RN bundle the Android face for both platforms

systems.name: Condensed numerals

display.ios: DIN Condensed Bold (numerals) / SF Pro Condensed 700

systems.rule: condensed for numerals and short labels only; sentences stay in the text face; React Native cannot select SF width/optical variants through fontFamily — on RN bundle the Android face for both platforms

systems.name: Rounded native
systems.rule: rounded for display and numerals; avoid for dense data

systems.name: Charter voice
systems.rule: sentences and titles in Charter; UI labels in system

systems.name: Old-style book
systems.rule: old-style figures only in prose; tabular lining figures for data

systems.name: Didone contrast
systems.rule: display >= 28pt only (hairlines vanish below); never for numerals in tables; legibility floor: this face only at ≥ 20pt and never for labels, kickers or meta (those stay in the text face at ≥ 13pt)

systems.name: Ledger serif
systems.rule: amounts in system tabular; Baskerville for headings and the running position label

systems.name: Geometric poster
systems.rule: short words only; generous tracking on small labels; never paragraphs; legibility floor: this face only at ≥ 20pt and never for labels, kickers or meta (those stay in the text face at ≥ 13pt)

systems.name: Humanist geometric
systems.rule: Avenir Next Condensed for dense labels; weights 500-800 only

systems.name: Railway humanist
systems.rule: Gill's quirky figures: use system tabular for data

systems.name: Flared sans
systems.rule: pair with a cool or green ground, not cream (priors)

systems.name: Calligraphic serif
systems.rule: italic for the one human sentence on a screen, not for emphasis words (frontend tell)

systems.name: Slab industrial
systems.rule: slab for headings and stamps; system for everything read in sentences

systems.name: Typed record
systems.rule: only for the artefact's typed fields; never body copy; no mono for decoration (priors); legibility floor: this face only at ≥ 20pt and never for labels, kickers or meta (those stay in the text face at ≥ 13pt)

systems.name: Margin hand
systems.rule: handwriting only for marks and short annotations (<= 6 words); titles and body stay system; legibility floor: this face only at ≥ 20pt and never for labels, kickers or meta (those stay in the text face at ≥ 13pt)

systems.name: Engraved signage
systems.rule: max 3 words per use; never for numbers that change; legibility floor: this face only at ≥ 20pt and never for labels, kickers or meta (those stay in the text face at ≥ 13pt)

systems.name: Native serif, tight

display.android: Noto Serif Display 700 / Source Serif 4 opsz 60

systems.rule: common choice for Kinetic arms (priors): only with a non-paper ground and a heavy weight, never 400 on warm paper

systems.name: System, heavy contrast
systems.rule: the voice is the weight contrast (900 vs 400) and size jumps (>= 1.8x); React Native cannot select SF width/optical variants through fontFamily — on RN bundle the Android face for both platforms

systems.name: Data mono
systems.rule: only when the data is code-like (IDs, hashes, readings); small mono labels as decoration are a prior

systems.name: Garden serif
systems.rule: pair with a field colour from nature (moss, sky), never cream + terracotta
